lines.zh: 翅膀一拍，空气里多出一层回声。
lines.en: One wingbeat leaves an extra layer of echo in the air.

lines.zh: 爵士维度的风把我的叫声吹成两半。
lines.en: The jazz wind splits my call into two halves.

lines.zh: 我在半空画圈，等你抬头。
lines.en: I circle overhead, waiting for you to look up.

lines.zh: 翅膀薄膜抖一下，回声就散开了。
lines.en: My wing membrane quivers and the echo scatters.

lines.zh: 别抬头太久，俯冲只要一瞬。
lines.en: Do not look up too long; the dive takes one instant.

lines.zh: 我的回声先碰到你，身体还在后头。
lines.en: My echo reaches you first; my body follows later.

lines.zh: 空气在这里有节拍，我踩着它飞。
lines.en: The air here has a beat, and I fly on it.

lines.zh: 蝠翼掠过时，你的耳朵会先疼。
lines.en: When my wings pass, your ears ache before your skin.

lines.zh: 我贴着树顶走，像一枚会响的钉子。
lines.en: I skim the treetops like a ringing nail.

lines.zh: 回声告诉我你站在哪块石头上。
lines.en: The echo tells me which stone you stand on.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在你脚边，别误会。
lines.en: My shadow lands at your feet; do not misunderstand it.

lines.zh: 飞行的路线是我喊出来的。
lines.en: My flight path is something I shout into being.

lines.zh: 爵士乐越响，我的翅膀越稳。
lines.en: The louder the jazz, the steadier my wings.

lines.zh: 我绕第二圈时，通常已经决定要落。
lines.en: On my second loop, I have usually decided to drop.

lines.zh: 我扇了两下翅膀，掠到舞台上方。
lines.en: I beat my wings twice and sweep over the stage.

lines.zh: 我贴着鼓声的间隙飞过去。
lines.en: I fly through the gaps between the drumbeats.

lines.zh: 悬停很费翅，但我喜欢听回声。
lines.en: Hovering costs wingbeats, but I like hearing the echo.

lines.zh: 我停在半空，把耳朵转向你。
lines.en: I hang in the air and turn my ears toward you.

lines.zh: 这里太安静了，我拍两下补点声音。
lines.en: Too quiet here; I clap my wings to add sound.

lines.zh: 回声回来得慢，说明前面有空。
lines.en: The echo returns slowly, so there is open space ahead.

lines.zh: 我的翅尖在滴一种听不见的水。
lines.en: An inaudible kind of water drips from my wingtips.

lines.zh: 爵士维度连沉默都带鼓点。
lines.en: Even silence in the jazz dimension keeps a drumbeat.

lines.zh: 我在数你的呼吸，一共四拍。
lines.en: I am counting your breaths: four beats so far.

lines.zh: 别动，让我把这块地方听清楚。
lines.en: Stay still and let me hear this place clearly.

lines.zh: 两只蝠翼互相摩擦，像旧琴弦。
lines.en: My two wings rub together like old strings.

lines.zh: 我不饿，只是想试试俯冲的角度。
lines.en: I am not hungry; I only want to test a dive angle.

lines.zh: 空中没有东西可捡，我从不落地。
lines.en: There is nothing to pick up in the air; I never land.

lines.zh: 回声里有一个多余的影子，是你。
lines.en: There is an extra shadow in the echo: you.

lines.zh: 你在看我，我也在听你。
lines.en: You are watching me; I am listening to you.

lines.zh: 抬头，我要确认你的肩膀宽度。
lines.en: Look up; I need to confirm the width of your shoulders.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛反光，回声都乱了。
lines.en: Your eyes reflect light and my echo goes messy.

lines.zh: 我认得这种抬头，猎物都会这样。
lines.en: I know that upward look; prey always does it.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我正在记你的位置。
lines.en: Do not blink; I am memorizing where you are.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸声在回音里特别粗。
lines.en: Your breathing sounds especially coarse in the echo.

lines.zh: 那双眼睛，我先啄哪一个好。
lines.en: Those eyes; which one should I strike first?

lines.zh: 你站得很稳，可惜头顶是空的。
lines.en: You stand firm, but the sky above you is empty.

lines.zh: 我看见你手里的东西了，没用。
lines.en: I see what is in your hands; it will not help.

lines.zh: 对，就这样看着我，别转身。
lines.en: Yes, keep watching me; do not turn around.

lines.zh: 你打断了我的回声，翅膀一歪。
lines.en: You broke my echo and one wing tilts.

lines.zh: 疼在翅骨里，像有人敲了一下钟。
lines.en: The pain sits in my wing bone like a struck bell.

lines.zh: 我的叫声变了调，你听出来了吗。
lines.en: My call changed pitch; did you notice?

lines.zh: 血从翅膜边缘滴下去，我看不见。
lines.en: Blood drips off my membrane where I cannot see it.

lines.zh: 这一下把我从空中打低了两尺。
lines.en: That blow dropped me two feet out of the air.

lines.zh: 我疼得听不清你的位置了。
lines.en: The pain has muddled where you are.

lines.zh: 别以为打中一次就能结束。
lines.en: Do not think one hit ends this.

lines.zh: 只要翅膜没破，我就能再升空。
lines.en: As long as the membrane holds, I can climb again.

lines.zh: 我掉了一撮绒毛，飘得很慢。
lines.en: I lost a tuft of down and it drifts slowly.

lines.zh: 你的武器很硬，我的骨头也是。
lines.en: Your weapon is hard; so are my bones.

lines.zh: 你把食物举高，我只会从上面俯冲。
lines.en: Raise the food and I will only dive from above.

lines.zh: 我不吃这个，我的牙齿给别的东西用。
lines.en: I do not eat that; my teeth are for something else.

lines.zh: 那块肉晃得很香，可惜我不是地里的兽。
lines.en: That meat smells good, but I am no ground beast.

lines.zh: 举着食物的人，肩膀会先僵。
lines.en: People holding out food stiffen at the shoulder first.

lines.zh: 我靠近了，不是馋，是借你的手当靶。
lines.en: I come close, not hungry, but using your hand as a mark.

lines.zh: 食物在回音里只是一团软影子。
lines.en: In the echo, food is only a soft blob of shadow.

lines.zh: 你喂我，我就记住你站的位置。
lines.en: Feed me and I will remember where you stood.

lines.zh: 爵士维度的兽不吃面包。
lines.en: Beasts of the jazz dimension do not eat bread.

lines.zh: 收起来吧，我不想踩脏它。
lines.en: Put it away; I do not want to dirty it.

lines.zh: 香味挡不住我的耳朵。
lines.en: Smell cannot block my ears.

lines.zh: 撞上我的翅骨，你的肩膀会麻。
lines.en: Hit my wing bone and your shoulder will go numb.

lines.zh: 别挤过来，我悬停需要空间。
lines.en: Do not crowd me; hovering needs room.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀比看上去硬。
lines.en: My wings are harder than they look.

lines.zh: 你碰到的是回声，不是身体。
lines.en: What you touched was echo, not flesh.

lines.zh: 让开半步，我就能借风转过去。
lines.en: Step half a pace aside and I can turn on the wind.

lines.zh: 这一撞把我推得偏了半尺。
lines.en: That bump pushed me half a foot off course.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，声音比疼更响。
lines.en: We collide, and the sound rings louder than the pain.

lines.zh: 你挡路，我就从你头顶翻过去。
lines.en: Block my path and I will flip over your head.

lines.zh: 皮下是空心的骨，撞起来像鼓。
lines.en: Hollow bone under the skin, it booms like a drum.

lines.zh: 碰撞之后，先站稳的是我。
lines.en: After the collision, I am the one still balanced.

lines.zh: 两只蝠翼对唱，回声会叠成一条。
lines.en: Two wings sing against each other and the echoes stack.

lines.zh: 我用翅尖敲你，这是求偶的鼓点。
lines.en: I tap you with my wingtip; that is a courtship beat.

lines.zh: 她听得懂我第三声回旋。
lines.en: She understands my third circling call.

lines.zh: 我们在空中交错，谁都不落地。
lines.en: We cross in the air, and neither of us lands.

lines.zh: 叫声越尖，说明我越认真。
lines.en: The shriller my call, the more serious I am.

lines.zh: 双翼展开，把回声撑成一片屋顶。
lines.en: Wings spread, we stretch the echo into a roof.

lines.zh: 伴侣只认同一个调子。
lines.en: A mate only answers the same tune.

lines.zh: 我绕着她飞了三圈才敢靠近。
lines.en: I circled her three times before daring to come close.

lines.zh: 我们把巢挂在谁也够不着的音里。
lines.en: We hang our nest in a pitch nobody can reach.

lines.zh: 别打扰，这段合唱只有两拍。
lines.en: Do not interrupt; this duet lasts only two beats.

lines.zh: 我没有手，捡东西这件事与我无关。
lines.en: I have no hands; picking things up is not my business.

lines.zh: 地上那枚硬币，我用影子盖住它。
lines.en: I cover that coin on the ground with my shadow.

lines.zh: 你把东西丢下，我只会绕一圈看。
lines.en: Drop something and I will only circle it once.

lines.zh: 我的爪子只用来抓肩膀。
lines.en: My claws are only for gripping shoulders.

lines.zh: 掉落的物品对我没用，我从不搬。
lines.en: Dropped items mean nothing to me; I never carry them.

lines.zh: 捡起来的重量会让翅膀失衡。
lines.en: Any picked-up weight would throw my wings off balance.

lines.zh: 我只是俯身看了一眼，没有拿。
lines.en: I only dipped down for a look; I took nothing.

lines.zh: 空手飞才追得上你的呼吸。
lines.en: Only empty claws can keep pace with your breathing.

lines.zh: 那东西反光，晃得我回声发花。
lines.en: That thing glints and blurs my echo.

lines.zh: 杀了我，地上也不会多出东西。
lines.en: Kill me and nothing will appear on the ground.

lines.zh: 回声勾勒出你的轮廓，我锁定了。
lines.en: The echo outlines you; I have locked on.

lines.zh: 你动了一下，我的耳朵就转向你。
lines.en: You moved once and my ears turned to you.

lines.zh: 高度够了，剩下的交给重力。
lines.en: Altitude is enough; gravity can do the rest.

lines.zh: 我看见颈侧有一块没遮住。
lines.en: I see one uncovered spot on your neck.

lines.zh: 从上方看，你只有一小块。
lines.en: From above you are only a small patch.

lines.zh: 叫声停了，说明我要开始了。
lines.en: My call stops, which means I am about to begin.

lines.zh: 你脚下的影子归我了。
lines.en: The shadow under your feet is mine now.

lines.zh: 我选你，因为你抬头了。
lines.en: I choose you because you looked up.

lines.zh: 这一片空域，只留一个目标。
lines.en: This patch of sky keeps only one target.

lines.zh: 锁定之后，风都变直了。
lines.en: After locking on, even the wind runs straight.

lines.zh: 我压住翅膀，把身体折成一支箭。
lines.en: I fold my wings and shape my body into an arrow.

lines.zh: 再等一拍，等你的肩膀放松。
lines.en: One more beat, until your shoulders relax.

lines.zh: 你在往左挪，我就往左偏半寸。
lines.en: You drift left, so I lean half an inch left.

lines.zh: 回声每回来一次，我就低一分。
lines.en: Each returning echo brings me a little lower.

lines.zh: 我的影子在你脸上停住了。
lines.en: My shadow has stopped on your face.

lines.zh: 你听见的尖啸，是最后一段计算。
lines.en: That shriek you hear is the final piece of arithmetic.

lines.zh: 别跑，跑动会让俯冲更准。
lines.en: Do not run; running only makes my dive truer.

lines.zh: 翅尖对准喉咙，剩下的风会补上。
lines.en: Wingtip on your throat; the wind does the rest.

lines.zh: 我把高度换成速度，很快。
lines.en: I trade height for speed, and it is quick.

lines.zh: 三声心跳之后，现在。
lines.en: Three heartbeats from now... now.

lines.zh: 我的喙撞上肩膀，回声都碎了。
lines.en: My beak hits your shoulder and the echo shatters.

lines.zh: 这一抓不求深，只求你别站稳。
lines.en: This rake is not deep; it only wants you off balance.

lines.zh: 翅膀扫过，你会听见骨头的响。
lines.en: My wing sweeps past and you hear bone rattle.

lines.zh: 六点五点的疼，够你记住我。
lines.en: Six and a half points of pain; enough to remember me.

lines.zh: 我从上面来，你挡错了方向。
lines.en: I come from above; you blocked the wrong way.

lines.zh: 爪子勾住衣领，再往上就是皮。
lines.en: My claws catch your collar; above it is skin.

lines.zh: 落地之前，我还能再抓一次。
lines.en: Before I land, I can rake you once more.

lines.zh: 你的血溅到翅膜上，很滑。
lines.en: Your blood on my wing membrane makes it slippery.

lines.zh: 别捂头，我要的是脖子。
lines.en: Do not cover your head; I want the neck.

lines.zh: 这次只是试探，下次对准动脉。
lines.en: That was only a test; next time I aim for the artery.

lines.zh: 我从爵士维度的鼓点里落下来。
lines.en: I drop out of the jazz dimension's drumbeat.

lines.zh: 空中先有回声，然后才有我。
lines.en: First comes the echo in the air, then me.

lines.zh: 翅膀张开的声音，就是我来过的证明。
lines.en: The sound of wings opening proves I was here.

lines.zh: 这片天原本是空的，现在归我。
lines.en: This sky was empty; now it is mine.

lines.zh: 我从上往下看你，先记住你的头顶。
lines.en: I look down at you and memorize the top of your head.

lines.zh: 一声尖啸，维度的裂缝合上了。
lines.en: One shriek, and the dimension's crack closes.

lines.zh: 别找了，我在你正上方。
lines.en: Stop searching; I am directly above you.

lines.zh: 我刚学会飞，就学会了俯冲。
lines.en: I learned to dive the same day I learned to fly.

lines.zh: 这里的风把我推到了你面前。
lines.en: The wind here pushed me in front of you.

lines.zh: 我来时没有脚步声，只有回音。
lines.en: I arrived with no footsteps, only an echo.

lines.zh: 火苗烧到翅膜，我闻见焦味。
lines.en: Flame catches my wing membrane and I smell it burning.

lines.zh: 我从半空砸下来，回声摔散了。
lines.en: I hit the ground and my echo breaks apart.

lines.zh: 水灌进翅膀，我像一块湿布沉下去。
lines.en: Water fills my wings and I sink like wet cloth.

lines.zh: 气浪掀翻了我，方向全乱了。
lines.en: The blast flips me and every direction is wrong.

lines.zh: 箭在翅膜上开了个会叫的洞。
lines.en: The arrow opens a hole in my wing that whistles.

lines.zh: 药水味钻进回声里，我晕了一下。
lines.en: Potion smell seeps into my echo and I reel.

lines.zh: 我饿得翅膀发轻，飞不稳。
lines.en: Hunger makes my wings light and my flight unsteady.

lines.zh: 雷声比我的回声还响，我聋了一瞬。
lines.en: Thunder outshouts my echo and I go deaf for a moment.

lines.zh: 虚空把我的回声拉长成一条线。
lines.en: The void stretches my echo into a single thread.
